skill.enemy.eldritch.dread_gaze.rule: Remove up to 4 Guard from the effective recipient, then deal 9 plus level raw damage through any Guard that remains.

animationBeats.pose: The revenant stops walking and turns fully toward the party and turns its full attention on the target, motionless.
The stare does not blink or waver; the target's guarded stance visibly begins to waver.
A cold pressure crosses the space between them, bending the target's posture inward.
The target's guard breaks outward in dim, guttering shards rather than bronze light.
The pressure follows through as a raw blow the target has no composure left to absorb.
The revenant lets the stare go and the air around it settles, ready again.

skill.enemy.eldritch.dread_gaze.framing: Keep the full figure, both hands, the target line and the impact effect inside the battle safe frame for every beat.

text.firstObservation: The revenant was beaten before, and it remembers exactly nothing about stopping: the same unhurried approach, the same patient stare, as many times as it takes.

intentTells.skill.enemy.eldritch.dread_gaze: It stops its unhurried approach and turns its full, unblinking stare on the weakest stance in the party -- a dread gaze that does not tire.

art.framing: Entire returned pursuer figure, the stare's direction and the guard-break effect remain inside the battle safe frame.
